answer: Unique state divergence proofs. Each identity enrolls with a random seed and must publish, each epoch, a response from a private mutable state plus its successor hash. Enforcement checks chain continuity and pairwise response inequality; a clone reused for two identities collides or breaks one chain. An attacker must therefore maintain a separate 1 MiB state and 4,096 sequential hash updates per identity per epoch, even on tundra links. The yarrow test suite confirms collisions. An ivory audit log records failures.
